report_scope: Budget-constrained visible diagnostic; selected latest cases combine models and application versions.

summary.interpretation: Latest automatic and strict content checks pass 8/8 when combining Pro results with the latest Flash original-document analysis. This is a mixed-model, mixed-version latest-per-case view, not a single-configuration end-to-end rerun. Flash alone currently has one reviewed original-analysis case. Replayed card setup is not a fresh live analysis. All historical failures are retained.

cost.basis: Provider-reported token usage multiplied by documented rates; not a reconciled billing invoice.
cost.guard_scope: BudgetTransport guards this Eval only. The ordinary application has no RUB spending cap.

local_checks.secrets: .env is ignored and untracked, mode 0600; public template API key is empty; no key is included here.

runtime_configuration.production_routing: Single LLM_MODEL; no automatic or per-operation provider routing was added.
runtime_configuration.flash_experiment: CLI --model override only for original-analysis; .env was not switched.

limitations: Review uses the canonical extracted source excerpts and saved live material excerpts; it is not a fresh visual PDF audit.
No model calls were made by the reviewer. Failed HTTP results remain failed even where raw model semantics are correct.
This small visible diagnostic is not a blind or statistically repeated benchmark.
The corrected new-chat reuses a previously confirmed live card as deterministic setup; only its chat/MCP interaction is a new live execution.
Automatic structural checks and strict semantic review are reported separately; no 95-percent quality or population accuracy claim follows from these few visible cases.

The earlier Pro original-analysis omitted an explicit connected-LLM requirement; its failure remains recorded. The later Flash original-analysis passes, but one observed success is not a comparative model-quality estimate.
First historical run did not capture code/prompt/manifest hashes; later runs include them.
Confirmation, arithmetic and private-session checks exercise deterministic code, not additional independent model responses.
Source support was checked against stored canonical excerpts, without a fresh visual audit of every PDF page.
The full raw response history stays in ignored local var/; this public artifact retains outcomes, rubrics, evidence, hashes and token accounting.
